title: Numma Taaqeh
intro: Caylale mirac, kaxxa wale kee qaxmeqe taaqel yamixxige, amixxige sinni raceenak cuumi farmo hirge. Ta qammalsime wayte angaaraw ken mabla kee reedal taqabi kataasak, diplomaasih safar keenih abak, ken qilmih fokkaaqok gexxaamah, ellecaboh addah, sissin roociini giclo fanah gexa. Atu ta amoytiinih kinnaane kee ken amoytiinul inkih milaagteh tan tekkooka qaddossam duuddaa?
clues: Yoo kee yi ummatta ayro nassakaxxeeh, ni abbobtih gita katayak.
Kimbirô, hoopoe, caylale miraacak ayyufta yoh bahteh tan farmoytak sugte.
Ruube numih ixxiga gibbatuh, anu melleb le acwoowi ruubeh, takkay immay ruube num Yallak kaxxam mango gadda luk sugeemih taagah oson gacsen.
anu walah ruube numih cokmih buxa gufak naharal, yi qaxmeqe qarkayto assakat le gurral wokke inti urra.
Anu gufe wak, anu essereh sugem, merrayti qarkayto yiimi kinnim kee anu gacseh, ' toh celtam toh kaxxam tiya.'
Anu kaxxa hall addat culeeh, woo uddur, woo uddur, Nabiyyi Suleymaan xaqut, baadal tan Rabbih yan Yallih gabat culse.

outcome.label: Illacaboh Xalootu
options: Yalla gufnuh fayya le kalqata xisaanama.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
